scripts.check: for dir in packages/*/ examples/*/*/; do (cd "$dir" && tsc); done
scripts.update: bun update; for dir in packages/*/ examples/*/*/; do (cd "$dir" && bun update); done
scripts.update:latest: bun update --latest; for dir in packages/*/ examples/*/*/; do (cd "$dir" && bun update --latest); done
scripts.clean:hard: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules examples/*/*/{node_modules,.next,.output,tsconfig.tsbuildinfo} bun.lock && bun install
